import inspect
from solution import intersection_array


def test_issue_example():
    """Example: intersection_array([1,2,3,5,7,8,9,10],[1,2,4,8,9])==[1,2,8,9]."""
    result = intersection_array([1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 8, 9, 10], [1, 2, 4, 8, 9])
    expected = [1, 2, 8, 9]  # common of both sets is 1, 2, 8, 9 -> 4 items
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_no_common_elements():
    """Intersection of arrays with no shared values is empty."""
    result = intersection_array([1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6])
    expected = []  # 3 + 3 inputs share 0 values -> 0 items
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_both_empty():
    """Intersection of two empty arrays is empty."""
    result = intersection_array([], [])
    expected = []  # 0 + 0 inputs share 0 values -> 0 items
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_first_empty():
    """Intersection with first array empty is empty."""
    result = intersection_array([], [1, 2, 3])
    expected = []  # 0 + 3 inputs share 0 values -> 0 items
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_second_empty():
    """Intersection with second array empty is empty."""
    result = intersection_array([1, 2, 3], [])
    expected = []  # 3 + 0 inputs share 0 values -> 0 items
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_identical_arrays():
    """Intersection of identical arrays contains all values."""
    result = intersection_array([4, 5, 6], [4, 5, 6])
    expected = [4, 5, 6]  # 3 shared values: 4, 5, 6 -> 3 items
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_subset():
    """Intersection when second array is a subset of the first."""
    result = intersection_array([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], [2, 4])
    expected = [2, 4]  # shared values are 2 and 4 -> 2 items
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_single_match():
    """Intersection of single-element matching arrays has that element."""
    result = intersection_array([7], [7])
    expected = [7]  # 7 == 7 shares 1 value -> 1 item
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_single_mismatch():
    """Intersection of single-element different arrays is empty."""
    result = intersection_array([7], [8])
    expected = []  # 7 != 8 shares 0 values -> 0 items
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_unsorted_with_negatives():
    """Intersection finds shared values including zero and negatives."""
    result = intersection_array([-1, 0, 5, 3], [3, 0, 7])
    expected_sorted = [0, 3]  # shared values are 0 and 3 -> sorted [0, 3]
    assert sorted(result) == expected_sorted


def test_contract_returns_list():
    """Example compares result with == to a list so result must be a list."""
    result = intersection_array([1, 2], [2, 3])
    expected_type = list  # example expects [1, 2, 8, 9] which has type list
    assert isinstance(result, expected_type)


def test_contract_takes_two_parameters():
    """intersection_array(array_nums1, array_nums2) takes two arrays."""
    params = list(inspect.signature(intersection_array).parameters)
    expected = 2  # params are array_nums1 + array_nums2 -> 1 + 1 = 2
    assert len(params) == expected
